verdict.rationale: Airbyte OSS Core is explicitly self-hostable via abctl/Docker or Kubernetes, with quickstart docs confirming local deployment is quick and free. However, community evidence shows real friction: one user reported a basic docker-compose install failure, and another notes some features (e.g., security/SSO) are gated behind paid tiers, so the 'core product' self-hosted is real but not fully feature-equivalent to Cloud. Missing for 10: independent verification that self-hosted install is smooth at scale, and clarity on which AI-native features (Connector Builder AI Assist, MCP agents) are available in the self-hosted OSS build versus Cloud-only.
